correctness.rationale: For word length at most n-2 the unused transposition makes the A_n action transitive; for the last two word lengths parity gives two orbits. Signed deletion produces the explicitly derived matrices with odd determinant n and even top rank one with coefficient n/2. CW cancellation and sphere-wedge cofiber classification establish the complete homotopy types for n>=4; direct two-triangle attaching words establish n=3. Finite independent enumeration verifies orbit boundaries and Smith diagonals for n=3,...,8, without serving as the general proof.

value.rationale: The alternating subgroup is a canonical index-two symmetry of a classical topological complex. Its orbit spaces exhibit an all-width, parity-sensitive integral homotopy classification, torsion of unbounded order, and an additional top sphere exactly at even widths. This resolves a natural symmetry-quotient topology problem and is not explained by the existing nonequivariant sphere-wedge formula or rational character.
